title: Separation of distinct unit lattice faces
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ and let p = (ι, b), q = (ι', b') ∈ (Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) with ι and ι' strictly increasing and p ≠ q. Let y ∈ Euclid k with 0 < y_j < 1 for all j, and y' ∈ Euclid k with 0 ≤ y'_i ≤ 1 for all i. Put x := Φ_p(y) = toLp(b) + Σ_j y_j • e_{ι(j)} and z := Φ_q(y') = toLp(b') + Σ_j y'_j • e_{ι'(j)}, where e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1 and toLp(b) has coordinates (b_i : ℝ). Then 1 ≤ dist(x, z), or there is j : Fin k with min(y_j, 1 − y_j) ≤ dist(x, z).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (p q : (Fin k → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ)), StrictMono p.1 → StrictMono q.1 → p ≠ q → ∀ y y' : Euclid k, (∀ j, 0 < y j ∧ y j < 1) → (∀ i, 0 ≤ y' i ∧ y' i ≤ 1) → 1 ≤ dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) ∨ ∃ j, min (y j) (1 - y j) ≤ dist (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (q.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y' j • EuclideanSpace.single (q.1 j) (1 : ℝ))
